scripts.build:web: bun run report && bun run --cwd apps/web build
scripts.dbt: cd dbt && DBT_PROFILES_DIR=. uv run dbt build
scripts.deploy:api: bun run dbt && uv run python -m fdp.build && bun run --cwd apps/api deploy
scripts.deploy:web: bun run dbt && bun run build:web && bun run --cwd apps/web deploy
scripts.dev: bun run report && bun run --cwd apps/web dev
scripts.pipeline: uv run python -m ingestion.budget.fetch && uv run python -m ingestion.budget.extract_projects && uv run python -m ingestion.budget.extract_revenue_accounts && bun run dbt && uv run python -m fdp.build && bun run report
